description: Asks what the seeded forms of Rnd return and whether they repeat: Rnd with a negative seed followed by unseeded and positive and zero calls in one projection (run twice), the same negative seed twice and the same positive seed twice in one row, fractional, huge, Single/Double/Currency/Decimal and text-numeric seeds, Null, Boolean and Date seeds, a per-row seed over the rows of Mx and a per-row Rnd(-1), and the inner type of the result; and whether Randomize is admitted with and without a seed. Only seeded sequences are asked; the unseeded first value is not. Fixture r-expr-1b-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
